_comment: Single source of truth for the portfolio cards on index.html (Latest Work) and portfolio.html (full grid). Edit this file and run `npm run generate-cards` (or `npm run deploy:safe`, which runs it automatically) to regenerate both pages. Do not hand-edit the card markup in index.html/portfolio.html directly, it will be overwritten. 'date' values now reflect the real timeframes given in 'meta' (end year of the range, or the current year for anything still 'Present'). Several Mercer projects and a few Fidelity projects only have a shared year-range in 'meta', so they tie on 'date' and fall back to alphabetical order in the grid.

_schema.id: unique slug, used only for your own reference while editing this file
_schema.href: link to the project page, relative to the site root
_schema.image: true if images/projects/<id>/thumbnail.png exists and should be used as the card image, or null for a card with no thumbnail (e.g. Other Projects)
_schema.title: short card title shown on the portfolio grid
_schema.description: short category/label shown under the title on the portfolio grid, e.g. 'Design System'
_schema.meta: optional: company + timeframe shown as a small third line under the description, e.g. 'Mercer · 2013–2020'. Rendered only if present, safe to omit on new projects
_schema.date: year the project shipped/wrapped, e.g. 2024. Leave null until known. Once set, drives sort order on both the grid and the homepage's 3 featured cards (most recent first). Ties (equal dates, or several projects both undated) fall back to alphabetical order by title
_schema.featured: optional boolean. Breaks a tie (equal dates, or both undated) in favor of this project specifically for the homepage's 3 featured cards, so manual curation there survives even when several projects tie on date. Does not affect the full grid on portfolio.html, which always ties alphabetically
_schema.featuredTitle: optional: override title used only on the homepage's 3 featured cards, if it should read differently than the grid title
_schema.featuredDescription: optional: override description used only on the homepage's featured cards, typically a longer one-sentence summary than the terse grid description
